```artifact
Feature: Doctor's Consultation and Prescription Process

  Scenario: Doctor views pending appointments and provides consultation
  Given a doctor has logged into the system
  When the doctor views the list of pending appointments
  Then the doctor should see all pending appointments

  Scenario Outline: Consultation and Prescription Process
  Given a doctor has logged into the system
  When the doctor views the list of pending appointments
  Then the doctor should see all pending appointments
  And the doctor provides consultation for an appointment
  And the doctor prescribes medicines for the patient
  And the doctor prescribes lab tests for the patient
  And the doctor requests lab report for the patient
  And the lab report is released to the patient

  Examples:
    | Appointment Status | Patient Name | Doctor Name |
    | Pending           | John Doe    | Dr. Smith   |
    | Pending           | Jane Roe    | Dr. Smith   |
    | Pending           | Alex Doe    | Dr. Smith   |

  Scenario: Doctor prescribes medicines
  Given a doctor has logged into the system
  When the doctor prescribes medicines
  Then the doctor should prescribe medicines
  And the medicines should be requested to the concerned chemist

  Examples:
    | Patient Name | Doctor Name | Medicines Prescribed |
    | John Doe    | Dr. Smith   | Aspirin             |
    | Jane Roe    | Dr. Smith   | Ibuprofen           |
    | Alex Doe    | Dr. Smith   | Paracetamol         |

  Scenario: Lab tests prescription
  Given a doctor has logged into the system
  When the doctor prescribes lab tests
  Then the doctor should prescribe lab tests
  And the lab tests should be requested to the concerned lab

  Examples:
    | Patient Name | Doctor Name | Lab Tests Prescribed |
    | John Doe    | Dr. Smith   | Blood Test           |
    | Jane Roe    | Dr. Smith   | Urine Test           |
    | Alex Doe    | Dr. Smith   | X-Ray               |

  Scenario: Lab report release
  Given a doctor has logged into the system
  When the lab report is released
  Then the doctor should release the lab report
  And the lab report should be accessible to the patient

  Examples:
    | Patient Name | Doctor Name | Lab Report |
    | John Doe    | Dr. Smith   | Report 12345       |
    | Jane Roe    | Dr. Smith   | Report 67890       |
    | Alex Doe    | Dr. Smith   | Report 13579       |

Feature: Doctor's Consultation and Prescription Process

  Scenario: Doctor provides consultation and prescription
  Given a doctor has logged into the system
  When the doctor provides consultation
  Then the doctor should provide consultation
  And the consultation should be recorded
  And the prescription should be generated

  Examples:
    | Patient Name | Doctor Name | Consultation | Prescription |
    | John Doe    | Dr. Smith   | Consultation | Prescription |
    | Jane Roe    | Dr. Smith   | Consultation | Prescription |
    | Alex Doe    | Dr. Smith   | Consultation | Prescription |

Feature: Doctor's Consultation and Prescription Process

  Scenario: Doctor prescribes lab tests and medicines
  Given a doctor has logged into the system
  When the doctor prescribes lab tests and medicines
  Then the doctor should prescribe lab tests and medicines
  And the lab tests and medicines should be requested to the concerned lab and chemist

  Examples:
    | Patient Name | Doctor Name | Lab Tests | Medicines |
    | John Doe    | Dr. Smith   | Blood Test, Aspirin |
    | Jane Roe    | Dr. Smith   | Urine Test, Ibuprofen |
    | Alex Doe    | Dr. Smith   | X-Ray, Paracetamol |

Feature: Doctor's Consultation and Prescription Process

  Scenario: Lab report release and medicines request
  Given a doctor has logged into the system
  When the lab report is released and medicines are requested
  Then the doctor should release the lab report and request medicines
  And the lab report should be accessible to the patient
  And the medicines should be requested to the concerned chemist

  Examples:
    | Patient Name | Doctor Name | Lab Report | Medicines |
    | John Doe    | Dr. Smith   | Report 12345, Aspirin |
    | Jane Roe    | Dr. Smith   | Report 67890, Ibuprofen |
    | Alex Doe    | Dr. Smith   | Report 13579, Paracetamol |
```
